sources: results/* only; frozen policies P1t 8.0 dB, P3 7.5 dB, CG theta_D 0.16 theta_A 0.60 delta 0.45, CG-D development tables

1_chance_association.label: post hoc (internal review, 08.11.2026); not pre-specified
1_chance_association.rule: episode associated iff a predicted P (catalogue p_pred, any kind) lies in [t_on - 15 s, t_off]; shifted p_pred wrapped circularly inside the set's calendar span

shifts.days: 100 offsets, uniform 1..7 days, random sign, seed 7
shifts.minutes: 20 offsets, uniform 10..60 min, random sign, seed 7

2_catalogue_density.label: post hoc (internal review, 08.11.2026); not pre-specified
2_catalogue_density.definition: regional = catalogue kind 'regional' (<= 15 deg of the reference, ISC + USGS de-duplicated); per calendar day of the month in the set's availability; associated episodes per day; CG-P3 = difference of dismissed share of associated episodes in that month

truncated_before_2026-03.note: sensitivity: extended sets without 2026-03..2026-06, the months whose regional catalogue density fell to 4-9 per day

3_GWUS.label: post hoc (internal review, 08.11.2026); not pre-specified
3_GWUS.note: role WUS = G.WUS on these sets; on the KZ set it is KZ.PDGK and on the AK set an AK station, so those are not ablated

ablation.note: development: CG at the fixed theta_D 0.16 of Table B1 (the main development table uses fold thresholds 0.16-0.21)

4_KURK_merged_site.label: post hoc (internal review, 08.11.2026); not pre-specified
4_KURK_merged_site.merge: state YES if either YES; NO if either NO and none YES; MISSING if both MISSING

variants.a: merged site 0.25, G.WUS 0.20 (weights re-assigned by distance rank, two neighbours)
variants.b: merged site 0.25, G.WUS 0.15 (G.WUS keeps its original weight)

extended II.KURK.note: P3 is unchanged by the merge (it only asks whether any neighbour said YES); CG-D not computed: no development detectability table exists for a merged site

2024 II.KURK.note: P3 is unchanged by the merge (it only asks whether any neighbour said YES); CG-D not computed: no development detectability table exists for a merged site

6_AK_out_of_sample.label: post hoc (internal review, 08.11.2026); not pre-specified
6_AK_out_of_sample.method: operating points selected on IU.MAKZ development by analysis/oos_operating_points.py (selection code executed unchanged), applied to the AK episodes; CG-D uses the IU.MAKZ development table by role, as in the AK plan

7_multiplicity.label: post hoc (internal review, 08.11.2026); not pre-specified
7_multiplicity.family: the nine pre-specified margin contrasts (E3, K3, D1 x2, N3, N5, R3, R5, R6)
7_multiplicity.test: H0: difference >= 3 pp; p = (draws >= 3 + 1)/(draws + 1) from the published day bootstrap (days with episodes, 2000, seed 7) recomputed here; one-sided alpha 0.025, which is the 95 % two-sided interval rule of the plans; Holm step-down over the nine

8_detector_and_Pn.label: post hoc (internal review, 08.11.2026); not pre-specified
8_detector_and_Pn.Pn_travel_time_check: not derivable from detector_coverage.json: it holds counts only, no arrival-time residuals by distance or phase. Two facts from the code (not data): catalogue association uses the TauP iasp91 first arrival (pipeline/stage1_pipeline.py, min over arrivals), which is Pn beyond the crossover distance, not 5.5 km/s; the 5.5 km/s figure only sets the neighbour coincidence half-width d/5.5 + 5 s, and since the arrival-time difference between two stations for a phase of apparent velocity v is at most d/v, a Pn moveout (v ~ 8 km/s) fits inside a window built for 5.5 km/s (the window is wider than Pn needs, which admits more chance coincidences rather than missing Pn confirmations).
